_Candidate checks from analysis; enforcement must be inspected before a rule is admitted._

## The admission contract

A rule belongs here only if it names a command that fails when the rule is
broken. A rule nothing can check is a suggestion, and suggestions accumulate
until nobody reads the file. If you want a rule that has no enforcement yet,
the task is to build the enforcement, not to write the rule.

## The ratchet

Claim a ratchet only when the check supports it. Record existing failures
as a baseline; do not claim a global check ignores unchanged code.

### Stage 4 model pass — 2026-09-22

Four candidate commands were discovered. Two are **not this project's gates**: `npm run test` and `npm run lint` with cwd `evals/fixture` belong to the planted-defect fixture, which is a test subject. `eslint` is not even installed for it. Do not admit them.

Admitted after inspecting the implementation:

| Rule | Enforced by | Fails when |
|---|---|---|
| Routing data stays internally consistent | `node scripts/validate-forge.mjs` | a role has no workflow file, or a domain tag a detector can emit is handled by no lens, role signal or declared backlog entry |
| The four orderings agree | `node scripts/validate-forge.mjs` | a role is gated to a phase no transition reaches, section ownership disagrees with role gating, a role owns two sections, or a stage skill does not write its role's section |
| The ledger cannot be talked past | `node scripts/test-forge.mjs` (via `npm test`) | an illegal phase transition, an unapproved build, a Verifier running before the team, or a `finish` with unmet gaps is allowed |
| Routing is a pure function of its inputs | `node scripts/test-evals.mjs` (via `npm test`) | a golden case's tier, team, skip set or approval requirement changes |
| The cross-skill wire contract holds | `node scripts/test-contract.mjs` (via `npm test`) | a field a consumer reads is missing or empty, a foreign `analysis.schema` is swallowed, a rendered table says `UNKNOWN`, or a comment is counted as a route |
| The enforcement tier refuses, and fails open | `node scripts/test-guard.mjs` (via `npm test`) | an unapproved edit is allowed, a verify-phase edit is allowed, the kit's own bookkeeping is blocked, or any malformed input blocks work |
| Skills stay packageable and self-contained | `node scripts/test-packaging.mjs` (via `npm test`) | a skill needs a file outside its own directory, or the package omits one |
| Shipped docs agree with shipped behaviour | `node scripts/test-docs-consistency.mjs` (via `npm test`) | a documented command, role or path does not exist |
| The surveyor's deterministic stages behave | `bash scripts/test-scaffold.sh`, `bash scripts/test-artifacts.sh` (via `npm test`) | scaffolding escapes the project root, a managed block loses human text, or a half-open block is written |
| Every knowledge citation resolves | `node skills/ae-surveyor/scripts/verify-citations.mjs` (via `npm test` when `.dev/knowledge` exists) | a `path:line` names a missing file or an out-of-range line |
| The install lands the documented layout | `npm run test:install` | a skill file or lock entry is missing for any of the eight `AGENT_ID`s |

**Not a ratchet.** Every check is global and absolute — no baseline of tolerated failures, no changed-files scoping. All pass at the surveyed commit.

**Gaps — real invariants with no command behind them.** Per the admission contract these stay here as gaps rather than being written up as rules:

1. **`test-installer.mjs` cannot catch an unpublished skill.** It installs from the local working tree (`scripts/test-installer.mjs:31`), so an uncommitted skill directory passes. Staging with `git archive HEAD` would close it.
2. **No failing-test-first evidence.** `acceptance` for `bug` requires re-running the original reproduction, not that it existed and failed before the fix. `feature` carries `requires: []`. Only `refactor` has a mechanical check.
3. **Checks are not component-scoped.** `analyze.mjs` records a `cwd` per command entry; `audit` and `verify` do not filter by the components a diff touched.
4. **An interrupted Builder leaves no record.** `note` requires `--result` to exist, so a build interrupted mid-way records nothing beyond `phase: build`.
